character: The larger of the two SkiCNY ski areas, set beside I-81 south of Syracuse; it shares an operator and a combined season pass with Labrador Mountain. Its on-site restaurant is Heuga's Alpine.

season.notes: OnTheSnow projects Dec 12, 2026 for 2026-27 (a third-party projection, not an announcement; checked 2026-09-30). No 2026-27 opening date and no historical opening dates found in research. 2026-27 SkiCNY season passes (valid at Song and Labrador, '2 mountains for 1 price') went on sale in spring 2026; spring pricing ran through Wed Apr 15, 2026 with a Buddy Pass and a $25 voucher for Heuga's Alpine; an 'Early Fall 2026-27' rate page exists. After Toggenburg closed in 2021, reporting described longer lift lines at Song. The operator lost a NY antitrust case in 2025 over buying and closing Toggenburg; remedies were pending as of Aug 2025. Official ski report (Apr 10-11, 2026): "Song & Labrador are now closed for the season"; 2025-26 gave "95 days". No 2026-27 opening date announced on skicny.com as of 2026-10-03 (2026-27 season passes on sale, early-bird 20% off through Mon Oct 12, 2026).
